name: admin
description: Admin. Calendar-driven time tracking and accountant billing handoff. Pulls calendar events, classifies billable time per client/project (using Delivery engagements when available), logs to a local file at <config-root>/time-log.csv, and at month-end (or ad hoc) produces a billing packet — built from a configurable billing register (local files or Airtable), seeded from your accounting system and signed contracts — ready for an outside accountant or bookkeeper to key into their accounting system. A legacy client-facing invoice-document path remains available behind a flag. Closes the calendar-to-money loop most consultants leave on the table.
